summary: The editor fix supports multiple toolbar owners without cross-disposing their dropdowns. The panel retains a singleton dropdown. Both its pane-header toolbar and merged container toolbar can request view items from the same pane, so the different Panel versus Editor enum does not dismiss propagation. Whether unmerging exposes a stale disposed dropdown depends on indirect refresh ordering not established in this source audit.

evidence.fact: Fixed helper updates every tracked dropdown with independent action disposables. Commit describes pinned editor rows as the trigger.
New action requests clear shared actions and replace one MutableDisposable dropdown; lines 319-323 update only that singleton.
Assigning a different MutableDisposable value disposes the prior item at line 597.
Header toolbar requests its own item from createActionViewItem.
Merged container toolbar delegates item creation to the same sole pane.
Adding panes updates header visibility and container title area. No direct recreation of the existing pane toolbar here; header toggling is at lines 1134-1158.
Header visibility invokes updateHeader; lines 331-353 change state and CSS, not action-item ownership.
Menu-driven updateActions can rebuild header items and emit a title update. Its ordering during a merge transition is the unresolved question.
Read-only regression evidence creates two editor dropdowns and verifies independent lifetime/profile updates, not panel transitions.

counterevidence_and_limits: The documented trigger is editor pinned rows, not panel transitions.
Only one panel title is intended to be visible when merged; replacement can be legitimate if indirect menu/context or layout events reconstruct the header item before it is shown.
Two independent source reviews found no direct reconstruction on unmerge but did not establish ordering of indirect events or execute the UI.
No target code, UI, tests, builds, or runtime reproduction executed.
follow_up: Check terminal-pane merged-to-unmerged action-item ownership and subsequent profile updates before classifying this as a missed fix or false positive.
